gloss: Obon holidays; summer holiday around the Bon festival

definitions.gloss: Obon holidays; summer break around the Bon festival
definitions.explanation: The mid-August holiday period centered on the Buddhist {お盆|ぼん} festival honoring ancestral spirits, during which many businesses close and people return to their hometowns.

examples.japanese: {盆休|ぼんやす}みは{実家|じっか}に{帰|かえ}る。
examples.english: I go back to my parents' home for Obon.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}の{盆休|ぼんやす}みは{一週間|いっしゅうかん}ある。
examples.english: This year we have a week off for Obon.

examples.japanese: {盆休|ぼんやす}みの{時期|じき}は{帰省|きせい}ラッシュで{新幹線|しんかんせん}も{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}も{大|おお}{混雑|こんざつ}する。
examples.english: During the Obon holiday period, both the Shinkansen and the expressways get extremely crowded with returning travelers.

notes:
Compound of {盆|ぼん} (the Bon festival) + {休|やす}み (rest, holiday). Centers on August 13–16 in most of Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {盆休|ぼんやす}みに{入|はい}る: to begin the Obon holiday
- {盆休|ぼんやす}み{中|ちゅう}: during the Obon holidays
- {盆休|ぼんやす}みの{帰省|きせい}: returning home for Obon
- {盆休|ぼんやす}み{明|あ}け: just after the Obon holidays

CULTURAL NOTE:
Unlike {正月|しょうがつ} (New Year) and ゴールデンウィーク (Golden Week), {盆休|ぼんやす}み is not a legally mandated holiday — its length varies by company, usually 3 to 7 days. Despite this, it is one of Japan's three major travel periods, with massive congestion on highways and bullet trains.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- お{盆|ぼん}: the Obon festival itself — the religious observance rather than the work holiday
- {夏|なつ}{休|やす}み: summer vacation — broader, especially used for school summer break
